title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
summary: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.
body: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.
summaryZh: OpenAI近日推出了名为Jalapeño的定制推理芯片，旨在为现代AI模型提供行业领先的速度与能效。该芯片能够实现更高的吞吐量和更低的延迟，标志着OpenAI在底层AI基础设施和推理硬件自主化方面迈出了重要一步，对降低大模型运营成本具有深远影响。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI发布了首款定制推理芯片Jalapeño，旨在提升大模型推理速度与能效。
